goal: Buy an exact quantity of one item through the GE with an owned funded actor, within a limit price and a cash reserve. Bank the filled items, refund any unfilled part, reconcile coins and items against the journal, and confirm logout. A rerun with the same order key must resume, not buy a second time.
consumer: The buyer's saved bank shows the exact purchased quantity of the item (for example grapes 1987 or jug of water 1937). Coins went down by no more than quantity x limit. The reserve is kept and the logout is clean. Those stock rows are the input for wine-order staging.
